Terms are FOB Origin, Inspection and Acceptance at Destination.  First Destination Transportation applies.  Item has a QCC of DCA. Requested quantity is 13 each.   This item is a Critical Application Item.   This item requires NIST certification. Requested delivery schedule is as follows:

CLIN #1/Production Quantity - 240 days ARO

This NSN will be solicited as Other Than Full and Open Competition utilizing solicitation and award procedures IAW FAR 15.

Approved Sources:

NORTHROP GRUMMAN SYSTEMS CORPORATION

CAGE: 70974

P/N: 175225

The final contract award decision may be based upon a combination of price, past performance and other evaluation factors as described in the solicitation. A copy of the solicitation will be available via the DLA Internet Bid Board System (DIBBS) at

DIBBS RFP/IFB/Other RFQs Search Page (dla.mil) on the issue date cited.  Enter the solicitation number within the search value area and click the submit button. Solicitations are in portable document format (PDF). To download and view these documents, the latest version of Adobe Acrobat Reader is required.  A paper copy of this solicitation will not be available to requestors.

The solicitation will be issued on or about May 26, 2026 and close on or around July 1, 2026.
